_doc: Weights of the normalised cost J = w_time*T + w_crowd*E + w_transfer*X + w_walk*W. Each component is min-max normalised across the candidate set of one search (0 = best candidate, 1 = worst). Edit here, not in code.
_unknown_doc: Segments with no defensible prediction are scored at the network 75th percentile (conservative) so missing data never looks like an empty bus.
